brand.name: Cedar Ridge Chiropractic
brand.description: A family chiropractic clinic in Austin, Texas offering spinal adjustments, posture care, and sports injury rehab. Same-day appointments for new patients.
brand.target_audience: Adults 30-60 with desk jobs, weekend athletes, and new parents in the Austin area.
usps: Board-certified chiropractors with 15+ years combined experience
Insurance accepted, plus transparent cash pricing
Digital posture scan included on your first visit

sourceFacts: Invite adults near Austin to learn about Cedar Ridge Chiropractic and enquire about a new-patient appointment. Create three distinct ideas using only saved Brand facts. Do not invent prices, discounts, deadlines, availability, credentials, reviews or health outcomes.

visual.medium: Flat vector illustration with subtle paper-grain texture
visual.direction: A single slightly curled paper receipt floats against a warm off-white background (#FAF6EF). On the receipt, two short printed lines are suggested by soft horizontal dashes — no legible text. A small hand-drawn circle in secondary gold (#FFC677) highlights the lower line, implying the included scan. One sprig of simple green cedar foliage rests beside the receipt's lower corner. Palette limited to brand blue #74A7FE, gold #FFC677, warm cream, and a muted sage green. Composition: receipt centred-left, upper two-thirds kept quiet and uncluttered for headline overlay. No people, no spine diagrams, no X-ray imagery, no medical symbols, no currency signs, no text of any kind, no drop shadows heavier than a soft ambient one.

concept.headline: $49 exam. Posture scan included.
concept.rationale: The value angle is served by pairing the concrete $49 price with the included posture scan and the insurance-plus-cash-pricing fact, framing value as transparency rather than a discount. Recent copy has led with 'one price' or 'no layered fees' phrasing; this ad leads with what is bundled inside the price and treats insurance acceptance as the second proof of straightforward value. The illustration shows a single receipt with two tidy line items, making the 'what you get for $49' idea visual without depicting a person, a clinic interior, or any medical imagery.
concept.description: Insurance accepted alongside transparent cash pricing. Same-day new-patient slots in Austin.
concept.primary_text: Cedar Ridge Chiropractic in Austin: a $49 new-patient exam and consultation that includes a digital posture scan. Insurance accepted alongside transparent cash pricing, so the number you see is the number you pay. Same-day appointments for new patients, evening and Saturday hours.
